notes: V30.31 makes RGB overlap the authority for panorama registration. Photo-only BRIEF/ZNCC correspondences are verified by robust homography RANSAC and converted into a visual rotation graph; AlvaAR pose and covariance are preserved per photo as a metric prior and disagreement diagnostic, not an epipolar veto. Raw Depth Anything maps are aligned statistically across verified RGB overlaps with robust affine consensus and confidence-aware source selection. The 3D reconstruction solvers are intentionally unchanged. The measurement GUI is camera-first with a collapsible panorama/depth diagnostics dock, and session/.r30 persistence now retains panorama registration evidence for later pose correction.
